request: Improve Safari map movement on a recent iPhone, retain visual quality

changes.sourceRead: One disposable CPU reader per source; no readback on the animated surface
changes.upload: Native dirty rectangle for local effects; direct full upload when animated bounds cover more than half the surface

limits: Linux WebKit headless is not iOS Safari hardware
No uniform FPS improvement claimed; snowy town frame intervals remain slow in the Linux WebKit harness
Control maps also fluctuate between runs
No new standalone MySQL or full historical suite
Touch pointers and visibility are simulated by the browser harness
